mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that heighten recession risk and depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 0.5pp rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening consumer spending momentum, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as housing sector contraction spreads.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with both RSAFS and HOUST declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth potential, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment exceeding $600 billion (RSAFS > 600000) signals robust consumer spending that supports economic growth and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS > 600000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate dual economic shocks that reduce aggregate demand and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
